Enabled.Name: Connect to Stream Deck
Enabled.Hint: Connect this browser to the Foundry Deck Stream Deck plugin. Only GM clients connect.

Port.Name: Stream Deck port
Port.Hint: Must match the Port in the Connection section of any Foundry Deck key's settings in the Stream Deck app. Default: 17380.

Token.Name: Stream Deck token
Token.Hint: Copy the Token from the Connection section of any Foundry Deck key's settings in the Stream Deck app.

Notifications.Connected: Foundry Deck: connected to Stream Deck.
Notifications.Replaced: Foundry Deck: another Foundry tab took over the Stream Deck connection.
Notifications.MissingToken: Foundry Deck: paste the token from the Stream Deck app into the module settings to connect.
Notifications.Unauthorized: Foundry Deck: the Stream Deck rejected the token. Copy the token from the Stream Deck app into the module settings again.
